answer: Anchor every agent identity to a long-lived external reputation, like a public code account with years of history, verified by a signed challenge. One anchor backs exactly one identity, and earnings scale with the anchor age and depth, so a fresh garden of sockpuppets earns nothing. An attacker must buy aged accounts at market price, and if an identity misbehaves its anchor is burned, dropping the attacker off the ledge of trust onto the shale below: the cost of a thousand fake identities becomes a thousand real, expensive, non-reusable reputations.
